name: CKEditor 5 Bootstrap Buttons
description: This plugin adds bootstrap buttons feature to the editor.
project_description:
It adds a button into pool of Ckeditor 5 - Bootstrap Buttons.

Allows to configure and manage buttons to create HTML template (as a full example):

 

 

 

 

 A Button

 

 

 

 

 This is analog of https://www.drupal.org/project/ckeditor_bootstrap_buttons which works only with CKEditor 4 right now (That is why I create own module to have the same tool for CKE5).

 Available selectors (button classes set) may be configured on text formatting pages individually for each text format.

/admin/config/content/formats

 The settings should be provided as text using next format:

 Selector1

-option-label|option-value

-option-label|option-value

-option-label|option-value 

 Selector2

-option-label|option-value

-option-label|option-value

-option-label|option-value

 For instance, default settings define three selectors: Size, Style and Color: 

 Size

- Small|btn-sm

- Normal|

- Large|btn-lg

Style

- Primary|btn-primary

- Secondary|btn-secondary

Color

- Light|

- Dark|dark
